revision_summary: Three quotes in script_coverage failed timestamp verification (all wrong_ts, words exist but at different times): (1) 'Dominion Energy is what I have.' is actually at ~03:07-03:08, not 02:26 (02:26 is the rep speaking, not the customer). (2) 'I'm, like, 75 years old...' is actually at ~04:33-04:36, not 03:55 (03:55 is the rep's bill-format question). (3) 'I got a 10:00 tomorrow...' is actually at ~07:17-07:22, not 06:56 (06:56 is the rep's morning/afternoon question). Fix all three customer_quote timestamps in script_coverage. Additionally: (a) tone down the handoff_brief.closer_should_know line instructing the closer to 'lead with concrete savings numbers against his $92.08 average bill' — this invents a prescriptive numeric coaching move not grounded in the call; reframe as 'closer should anchor on the customer's own cost-curiosity framing without fabricating a savings figure the setter never established.' (b) Reconsider the 'stagnant' trajectory shape label given the customer's own escalating engagement (voluntary vulnerability disclosure, unprompted full 12-month data readout) — either justify 'stagnant' as strictly rep-side energy or relabel to reflect the asymmetry between flat rep energy and rising customer effort. (c) Add the missed legitimacy-check moment at 02:49 ('Who are you folks based out of?') to cherry_pick_moments, graded against protocols.how_did_you_get_my_number. (d) Soften the credit-qualifier alternative_hypothesis in cherry_pick_moments[1] — the schema's stated-vs-pulled-credit question is an explicit Kenny TBD, not evidence this specific rep was executing a deliberate downstream-deferral strategy.
